note: Fact base for the marketing set. EVERY value here was read off an official page on 2026-11-14 and is quoted (or tightly paraphrased) from it. No value is inferred, averaged, or carried over from another session's ledger. associates_tag_note: No Associates ID is stored anywhere in this repository and none may be invented (Operating Agreement / Participation Requirements; ledger flag F-07). Every product link in this set is therefore emitted through tools/link_builder.py:preview_link() - a clearly labelled, non-monetized placeholder - and the site says so on every page that shows a link.
